description: This Java class implements a conditional operation (<if-not-empty>) for a mini language used within the Apache OFBiz framework. It evaluates if a specified field (via FlexibleMapAccessor) is not empty and executes different sub-operations based on that condition.

classes.name: IfNotEmpty
classes.description: Represents the <if-not-empty> element, executing specific operations based on whether a designated field is non-empty.

classes.name: IfNotEmptyFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IfNotEmpty from XML Elements.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Evaluates whether the specified field is not empty and executes the appropriate sub-operations.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information from sub-operations for analysis or processing.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the <if-not-empty> element.
